key.decision_why: The author asked for a re-review after only tweaking the commit message, so a short note is enough. The commit message still breaks the guidelines, so the triager needs to send more feedback. The code and approach are unchanged, so a new card isn't warranted.
key.action_why: On 2026-09-07 laurynmm replied with more work: the commit summary still lacked a period, and she asked for before/after screenshots with the mouse cursor visible, including one showing the tooltip still appearing in views with multiple topics.
changed: The author force-pushed twice; the only visible change is the commit summary, shortened from 'web: suppress redundant navigation tooltips...' to 'web:suppress redundant nav tooltips on dm recipients_row and topic'.
The code is unchanged: still +17/-6 in the same 2 files.
still_missing: The commit message still does not follow Zulip's commit guidelines: no space after 'web:', a lowercase summary, no trailing period, and file-style wording instead of a clear summary like 'tooltips: Suppress redundant navigation tooltips.'
The PR description has only video links, with no precise before/after screenshots showing the mouse cursor and the tooltip still present in interleaved views.
key.reply_ask: Tell the author the commit message still doesn't follow the commit-discipline guidelines (area prefix followed by a space, capitalized summary ending in a period) and ask them to fix it and add precise before/after screenshots with the cursor visible before asking for another look.

must_have.fact: Says the commit message still does not follow Zulip's commit message guidelines, so the requested change is not done.
